Symptoms: From a simple cold to severe lung infections, HMPV can mimic the flu or even lead to bronchitis and pneumonia, especially in the young or old. #HMPVSymptoms #RespiratoryHealth

How It Spreads: This virus loves the winter and spring, spreading through sneezes, coughs, https://t.co/m6xwoWaMkJ

nodes.author: anaveentalks
nodes.text: Genetic Diversity: HMPV and RSV (Respiratory Syncytial Virus) are like chameleons with their genetics. They're divided into groups and subgroups - A, B for HMPV, and A, B for RSV, with subtypes evolving rapidly due to immune pressure. #GeneticDiversity #HMPVGenetics #RSVGenetics https://t.co/fxTznnWWWB

nodes.author: anaveentalks
nodes.text:
HMPV's G Gene: The most variable part, it's like the virus's cloak, changing to dodge our immune system.
RSV's G Protein: Similarly, RSV's G protein is a shape-shifter, making vaccine development a puzzle.
